messages:
Alyssa: Quick sync on streaming handshake + launch criteria. Need a concrete decision on SSE vs WS, delta schema, and finish-reason semantics so we can lock SDK work.
Matt: My leaning is WS for v1 if we want multiplexing and client->server control messages. SSE is tempting for simplicity but limits two-way signals.
Ravi: Runtime view — WS gives us a stable channel for server-initiated control (cancels, model-switch). It costs more in connection mgmt but simplifies resume token mapping. SSE forces polling or separate control channel.
Jena: From SDK/mobile: SSE is easier for iOS background delivery but resume across flaky networks is harder. Web apps won't care as much.
Alyssa: Proposed compromise: API supports both transports from day 1, but we standardize a single handshake and delta contract so apps can swap transports without changing delta parsing. Handshake must include transport, delta_format, and resume preference.
Matt: Handshake example to be surfaced in docs:
```json
{ "transport": "ws", "delta_format": "json_ops", "resume": true, "client_version": "js-0.9.0" }
```
Ravi: We should enumerate finish reasons now. Minimal set: `completed`, `truncated` (token_limit), `cancelled` (client or server), `timeout` (SLO/window), `error` (internal). Add optional metadata: `truncated.reason` (e.g., max_tokens, safety), `error.code` if present.
Jena: UX acceptance: client must receive exactly one final finish event containing reason + final usage. Streaming must not emit an implicit final token after finish. Function calls should be delivered as discrete deltas `{type: "function_call", name, args}` so SDKs can surface them deterministically.
Alyssa: Launch gates checklist (high level):
- SDKs: JS, Python, iOS wrappers shipping streaming handshake + resume
- Server: handshake + session_id, per-connection rate limits, backpressure hooks
- Telemetry: p50/p95 latency for first delta, %sessions resumed, finish-reason distribution
- Docs: handshake examples for SSE/WS, delta format spec, migration guide
- Beta: 2 paying customers onboarded + 1 internal app
Measure thresholds: p95 first-delta < 150ms for hosted; resume success > 90%; ambiguous finish reason < 0.5%.
Matt: Ops items — implement soft backpressure header (X-Stream-Allow-Burst) and a server-initiated PAUSE event for WS. For SSE, we'll send an advisory event `:pause\n` and rely on client to throttle.
Ravi: Delta formats: keep three canonical modes and version them: `text_chunks_v1` (plain text fragments), `json_ops_v1` (op-based structured deltas with types like insert/function_call/meta), `rich_v1` (includes token-level provenance & model-scores). Default for launch = `text_chunks_v1` with an opt-in for `json_ops_v1`.
Jena: Mobile nuance — resume token storage encrypted in Keychain; SDK should auto-detect flaky network and attempt graceful resume up to N retries. Document privacy/sharing implications.
Alyssa: Rollout plan: internal dogfood week -> invite-only beta -> gradual ramp (10% customer traffic) -> GA. Each step requires: SDKs published, observability dashboards, and 2 P0 customers.
Matt: Implementation plan: prototype WS handshake server + simple SSE shim into runtime (this week). Also add a small simulator that replays flaky networks for resume testing.
Ravi: I'll draft the finish-reason JSON schema (fields + allowed values + example payloads) and the resume token format (signed, short-lived). Due Mon morning.
Jena: I'll draft the client SDK acceptance tests (duplicate final token checks, function_call reconstruction, resume flakiness tests). Due Tue.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy: streaming-handshake-proto v0.1 -> staging on 2026-03-25T22:00:00Z :rocket:
Alyssa: Ok, thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after the prototypes land. :thumbsup:
